answer_1.quote: Natural language generation (NLG) refers to the broad set of tasks that produce fluent text from input data and other contextual information.
answer_1.outputs: summaries, style transferred text, dialog responses

answer_2.quote: We propose a more unifying perspective of NLG evaluation through the lens of information change, which offers a general framework to measure many key aspects of NLG tasks.

answer_4.quote: we evaluate metrics using human annotations from two commonly-used sources: (1) SummEval on the CNN/DM summarization dataset... (2) QAGS on the XSUM dataset
answer_4.guideline: human annotations for aspects such as consistency, relevance, engagingness, and groundedness
